mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_document (document_id, user_id, active_version, status) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{userId}, #{activeVersion}, #{status}) ON CONFLICT (document_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_document SET active_version = #{version}, status = 'READY', content_hash = #{contentHash}, source = #{source}, activated_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'IMPORTING'
mapper.select: SELECT id, document_id, user_id, active_version, status, content_hash, source, activated_at, purged_at, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_document WHERE active_version > 0 AND activated_at IS NOT NULL AND activated_at < now() - make_interval(hours => #{retentionHours}) AND (purged_at IS NULL OR purged_at < activated_at) ORDER BY activated_at LIMIT #{limit}
